items.verbatim: Ohio Tax Credit Authority approved a Job Creation Tax Credit of 1.392% for 8 years on 2026-07-27 for a project in the City of Cleveland, Cuyahoga County. Commitment: create 120 full-time equivalent employees generating $7,104,000 in new annual payroll at the project location.
